svg.desc: Three axonometric drawings: symbolic stage plus specifications gives the specified stage. Symbolic stage: the block of the modularity figure, with its green arrival socket, its cyan continuation peg and two square pads on top, its two operators. Specifications: three separate groups of scattered pieces, four short plugs marked beta, rho, R and sigma, labelled parameter values, in the stage's navy; four tapered blocks named on their faces EGM, VFI, linear and Gauss-Hermite, labelled methods, in a middle blue; three dials with a flange and a pointer, labelled settings, in a light blue. Specified stage: the block with the plugs in its front face, the Gauss-Hermite and EGM blocks on its two pads, and a dial on each; the plugs slide into the face, then the methods and then the dials are lowered into place, once.
